evidence: A user enjoys Yori's polished Windows 2000 feel and autocomplete while noting it is less featureful than Kitty.

evidence_sources.author: marttt
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using Yori [1]. Not comparable at all to Kitty in terms of features, but a joy to use if you like a polished "Win2k feel" with only a handful of added unix-isms like decent autocomplete etc.
